name: Watt
frame: Roblox studs: Y up, the model on y = 0 facing -Z, HumanoidRootPart at (0, 3, 0)
rig: R6. Every piece carries the body's own surface: the six rig parts are hidden (Transparency 1), and the Head's face decal is removed. His face is on the Head piece.

emissive.note: One mask for both pieces; each takes its own EmissiveTint and EmissiveStrength: cold as he stands, hot in Ground Wire's hold. Roblox multiplies the glow by the colour map, so the hair's ends glow in their own pale pink, and the discs take Storm from their tint. The other five pieces take no glow, and his face none, ever. DESIGN: the strengths are the review's, untried in Studio. The glow stays at Storm's pale end, never deeper (the content check).

Spear.note: One piece on the Torso, its pivot at the grip's middle. With no turn it lies slung on his back, from behind his left calf to over his right shoulder: `along` is the shaft's line, from the butt to the blade. `stood` is how he stands, which his idle keys: the grip at his right fist, the shaft upright with its butt on y = 0, and his Right Arm turned from hanging to point along `right_arm`. In every clip the blade and discs stay clear of his head and neck, and the blade goes into the street only.
